_about: Every error Ferry can show, in three parts: what stopped, why, what to do. Keys are the Rust path of the variant, or Runtime:: for the engine's own. {detail} is filled by the engine. A test in ferry-core checks every variant has a row and no cell is empty. Words follow docs/voice.md.

AdbError::Failed.todo: Unplug and replug the cable. Check that USB debugging is on.

AdbError::NotFound.why: adb was not found on this Mac.
AdbError::NotFound.todo: Install Android platform tools, or use Wi-Fi.

AdbError::RelativeBinary.why: adb was found by a relative path, which Ferry refuses.
AdbError::RelativeBinary.todo: Install Android platform tools in the standard place.

AdbError::Timeout.why: adb did not answer in ten seconds.

AdbError::Unparseable.why: adb answered in a form Ferry does not understand.

ChunkSizeError::NotPowerOfTwo.why: The chunk size is not one BLAKE3 accepts.
ChunkSizeError::NotPowerOfTwo.todo: Report this. Nothing you did caused it.

ChunkSizeError::TooLarge.why: The chunk size is not one BLAKE3 accepts.
ChunkSizeError::TooLarge.todo: Report this. Nothing you did caused it.

ChunkSizeError::TooSmall.why: The chunk size is not one BLAKE3 accepts.
ChunkSizeError::TooSmall.todo: Report this. Nothing you did caused it.

DiscoveryError::Mdns.todo: Use the cable, or a different network.

DiscoveryError::NoRandomness.why: This device gave no random data.

FrameError::Io.todo: It reconnects on its own when the device is reachable.

FrameError::PayloadTooLarge.why: The device sent a message larger than Ferry accepts.

FrameError::UnknownKind.why: The device sent a message this version does not know.

FrameError::Wire.why: A message could not be decoded.

ManifestError::BadChunkSize.todo: Start it again. It begins from zero.

ManifestError::RootMismatch.why: Its saved record was changed by something else.
ManifestError::RootMismatch.todo: Start it again. It begins from zero.

ManifestError::TooManyChunks.todo: Start it again. It begins from zero.

ManifestError::Wire.todo: Start it again. It begins from zero.

ManifestError::WrongChunkCount.todo: Start it again. It begins from zero.

NoiseError::BadHandshakePayload.why: The other device sent a malformed handshake.
NoiseError::BadHandshakePayload.todo: Try again. If it repeats, update Ferry on both devices.

NoiseError::BadKeyLength.why: It is not the size Ferry expects.
NoiseError::BadKeyLength.todo: Forget every device and pair again. The key is made fresh.

NoiseError::BadPattern.todo: Report this. Nothing you did caused it.

NoiseError::CommitmentMismatch.why: The other device changed its identity during pairing. This can mean someone on the network interfered.
NoiseError::CommitmentMismatch.todo: Do not confirm. Try again on a network you trust, or over the cable.

NoiseError::Crypto.todo: If this keeps happening, forget the device and pair again.

NoiseError::HandshakeMessageTooLarge.why: The other end sent a handshake larger than Ferry accepts.
NoiseError::HandshakeMessageTooLarge.todo: Check that the other end is Ferry.

NoiseError::Io.todo: It reconnects on its own when the device is reachable.

NoiseError::MissingPeerKey.why: The other device sent no key.

OpError::AlreadyExists.why: Something with that name already exists.

OpError::Internal.why: The device reported an error it could not explain.
OpError::Internal.todo: Try again. If it happens again, restart Ferry on that device.

OpError::InvalidPath.why: It holds characters Ferry does not accept.
OpError::InvalidPath.todo: Rename the file with a plain name.

OpError::IsADirectory.stopped: The file could not be read.
OpError::IsADirectory.why: That path is a folder, not a file.

OpError::NotADirectory.stopped: The folder could not be opened.
OpError::NotADirectory.why: That path is a file, not a folder.

OpError::NotEmpty.todo: Delete the files inside it first.

OpError::NotFound.why: It is no longer at that path.

OpError::PermissionDenied.stopped: The file could not be accessed.
OpError::PermissionDenied.why: The device refused access to it.
OpError::PermissionDenied.todo: Check the shared folder setting on that device.

OpError::RangeTooLarge.why: It asked for more than one message may carry.

OpError::Unsupported.why: It is not a regular file or a folder.
OpError::Unsupported.todo: Nothing to do. Ferry serves files and folders only.

PathError::Absolute.todo: Rename the file with a plain name.

PathError::Backslash.todo: Rename the file with a plain name.

PathError::CurrentComponent.todo: Rename the file with a plain name.

PathError::Empty.todo: Rename the file with a plain name.

PathError::NulByte.todo: Rename the file with a plain name.

PathError::ParentComponent.why: It tries to go up a folder.
PathError::ParentComponent.todo: Rename the file with a plain name.

PathError::TooLong.todo: Rename the file with a plain name.

PeerError::BadKey.stopped: The device list could not be read.
PeerError::BadKey.why: It holds a key of the wrong size.
PeerError::BadKey.todo: Forget every device and pair again.

PeerError::Io.stopped: The device list could not be saved.
PeerError::Io.why: This device refused to write the file.

PeerError::NoRandomness.stopped: The device list could not be saved.
PeerError::NoRandomness.why: This device gave no random data.

PeerError::TooMany.why: Ferry holds at most 64 paired devices.
PeerError::TooMany.todo: Forget one you no longer use.

PeerError::UnknownFormat.stopped: The device list could not be read.
PeerError::UnknownFormat.why: It was written by a different version.
PeerError::UnknownFormat.todo: Forget every device and pair again.

PeerError::Wire.stopped: The device list could not be read.
PeerError::Wire.todo: Forget every device and pair again.

RpcError::BadName.why: It is empty, longer than 64 bytes, or holds a control character.
RpcError::BadName.todo: Choose a plain name of up to 64 characters.

RpcError::Frame.todo: It reconnects on its own when the device is reachable.

RpcError::MismatchedRequestId.why: The device answered the wrong request.
RpcError::MismatchedRequestId.todo: It reconnects on its own. If it repeats, update Ferry on both devices.

RpcError::UnexpectedFrameKind.why: The device sent a message out of order.
RpcError::UnexpectedFrameKind.todo: It reconnects on its own. If it repeats, update Ferry on both devices.

RpcError::Wire.why: A message could not be decoded.

Runtime::AllFilesAccess.stopped: Ferry cannot read the shared folders.
Runtime::AllFilesAccess.why: All files access is not granted.
Runtime::AllFilesAccess.todo: Grant all files access in Settings.

Runtime::NoCandidate.why: That candidate is no longer present.

Runtime::NotPaired.why: Its key is not in this device's list.

Runtime::NotReachable.why: It is not on the network and not on the cable.
Runtime::NotReachable.todo: Bring it onto the same Wi-Fi, or plug it in.

Runtime::PairingTimeout.why: No device appeared within two minutes.
Runtime::PairingTimeout.todo: Turn pairing on for the other device and try again.

Runtime::TransferNotFound.why: It is no longer in the list.

TcpError::Io.todo: It reconnects on its own when the device is reachable.

TcpError::Noise.why: The device did not prove it is the one paired.
TcpError::Noise.todo: If this keeps happening, forget the device and pair again.

TcpError::Timeout.why: The device did not answer in time.
TcpError::Timeout.todo: Check that Ferry is open and reachable on it.

TcpError::TooManyPending.why: Too many devices are connecting at once.
TcpError::TooManyPending.todo: Wait a moment and try again.

TcpError::Version.why: The two devices run versions that cannot talk.

TransferError::BadPath.why: Its saved record holds a bad path.

TransferError::ChunkFailedVerification.why: Part of the file did not match. The file changed on the other device during the transfer.

TransferError::Local.why: This device could not write the file.
TransferError::Local.todo: Check free space and the shared folder.

TransferError::NoRandomness.why: This device gave no random data.

TransferError::Record.todo: Start it again. It begins from zero.

TransferError::Rpc.todo: It continues on its own when the device is reachable.

TransferError::ShortRead.why: The other device sent less of the file than it said it holds. The file changed during the transfer.

VersionError::Io.todo: It reconnects on its own when the device is reachable.

VersionError::NoSharedVersion.why: The two devices run versions that cannot talk.

VersionError::NotFerry.why: The other end is not Ferry.

WireError::InvalidPath.stopped: A message could not be decoded.
WireError::InvalidPath.why: It held a path Ferry refuses.

WireError::NotUtf8.stopped: A message could not be decoded.
WireError::NotUtf8.why: Text in it was not valid.

WireError::TooLong.stopped: A message could not be decoded.
WireError::TooLong.why: A field in it was too long.

WireError::TrailingBytes.stopped: A message could not be decoded.

WireError::UnexpectedEnd.stopped: A message could not be decoded.

WireError::UnknownTag.stopped: A message could not be decoded.
WireError::UnknownTag.why: It used a tag this version does not know.
